text:
maria: Quick follow-up from the GPU postmortem. We need three concrete owners: quota backstop, scheduler defaults, and headroom runbook. Keep updates short here.

ev an: I can take scheduler defaults (A-sched). Plan: run 24h replay, validate preemption and backfill knobs, then open PR with conservative defaults. Target: 2025-06-04.

sam (oncall): include a 5-step smoke test we can run during a surge sim. I can run the sim Thu evening.

natalie: I'll own quota backstop (A-quota). Draft: soft per-team burst quotas + hard route to reserved pool on breach. Card + CSV by 2025-05-31.

ravi: I'll write the headroom playbook (A-headroom): 1-page checklist, escalation matrix, and an alert at 10% headroom. Draft by 2025-05-28.

maria: ops-bot, create a weekly 6-week check on Wednesdays 09:00 PT and invite the owners.

ops-bot: Created event "GPU capacity: remediation check" weekly Wed 09:00 PT. Invites sent. Link: https://calendar.redwood/internal/evt/10456

ev an: quick config I'll test in staging:
```
scheduler:
  preemption_deadline_ms: 60000
  backfill_window_sec: 30
```

sam (oncall): perfect. please post PR and test plan to the board and tag #incidents. I'll validate the fallback ladder (quantize -> smaller model -> rate-limit) during the sim.

maria: owners summary: A-sched evan 2025-06-04; A-quota natalie 2025-05-31; A-headroom ravi 2025-05-28. Post short updates to the cards. :thumbsup:
